plan.understanding: The customer wants the existing horizontal button on the functional front fascia—identified from the controls shown in [DATASET · top], corresponding to the world +Z side shown in [INPUT · front]—duplicated once above and once below in an evenly spaced vertical row.

subtasks.goal: Duplicate the complete existing horizontal button body s39 (faces #419-#424, bbox [-258.479,335.0,316.104] to [-215.521,345.0,320.896], center approximately [-237.0,340.0,318.5] mm) twice without changing its size or world-X horizontal orientation. Translate one copy to center [-237.0,360.0,318.5] mm and the other to [-237.0,320.0,318.5] mm, producing three buttons at a uniform 20 mm world-Y center pitch on the world +Z front fascia. Print the achieved centers and correct either translation in the same attempt if they do not land within 0.5 mm of those targets; verify all three copies remain congruent and horizontally aligned along world X. The index contains only the source member of this button family, and each target is an empty location 20 mm from it.
